newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline falls hard as NYMEX tumbles.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline falls hard as NYMEX tumbles.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices fell sharply on Friday as NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures crashed lower again, breaking through key support levels and creating new 11-month lows on the continuation chart, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at $196 and $197 a tonne fob ARA in the afternoon after NYMEX tumbled, having traded in the morning between $198 and $202.

Cargoes were not heard traded. But dealers said they expected that while U.S. arbitrage business was not workable, some material may move into the Mediterranean where a couple of prompt requirements remain unfilled.
